candidates.name: Schwannoma
support_spans: Image Description: A 35 × 9 mm sized mass occupying the spinal canal at T8-T9 level.
Immunohistochemical analysis: Neoplastic cells were negative for epithelial membrane antigen, pancytokeratin and desmin but diffuse positive for protein S-100.
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging studies suggest a spinal tumor, and the histopathological examination and immunohistochemical analysis are consistent with schwannoma.

candidates.name: Meningioma
support_spans: Image Description: A 35 × 9 mm sized mass occupying the spinal canal at T8-T9 level.
Description: Tumor consisted of elongated spindle cells with vesicular nucleus arrayed in a palisade pattern among large cystic cavities lined by single-layer squamous epithelium.
contradict_spans: Immunohistochemical analysis: Neoplastic cells were negative for epithelial membrane antigen, pancytokeratin and desmin but diffuse positive for protein S-100.
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging studies suggest a spinal tumor, but the immunohistochemical analysis is not typical for meningioma.
